WCA_WAL_NEAREST: WAL-0 (no provenance) / WAL-1 (provenance logged; crypto MAY be absent)
SLSA_V1_2_NEAREST: Build L0 (no guarantees) / Build L1 (provenance exists; may be unsigned; trivial to forge)
WHY_NOT_IDENTICAL: WAL/SLSA levels grade provenance of tool responses / build artifacts; NAC-0 grades a NEXUS capsule; none implies anything about claim truth
WHAT_NAC_MUST_ADD: Explicit marker that the capsule is UNBOUND and carries no authority

NAC_SEMANTICS: HASH_LINKED: byte integrity relative to trusted head; parent-pointer continuity
WCA_WAL_NEAREST: Partial: WAL-3 hash-chained attestation log component only (WAL-3 additionally requires RM1-RM3, signatures, nonces)
SCITT_RFC9943_NEAREST: Partial: VDS Merkle structure property, but SCITT always requires signed statements so no SCITT state equals unsigned hash linking
SLSA_V1_2_NEAREST: No direct level (SLSA binds provenance to artifact digests but levels are about platform/signature)
WHY_NOT_IDENTICAL: Hash linking without signatures proves no origin; WAL-3 and SCITT both bundle signatures

NAC_SEMANTICS: SIGNED: key possession over canonical bytes + required fields (KEY_ID, ISSUER, AUDIENCE, SCOPE, times, nonce, parent hash, canonicalization, domain separation)
WCA_WAL_NEAREST: WAL-2 (sources MUST sign responses; keys certified by Domain WCA; Ed25519 or P-256)
SCITT_RFC9943_NEAREST: Signed Statement (COSE_Sign1 with CWT iss/sub in protected header) before registration
SLSA_V1_2_NEAREST: Build L2 (signed provenance from hosted build platform)
OTHER_PRIOR_ART_NEAREST: JWS/COSE; Biscuit blocks; UCAN; RFC 8693 act chain
WHY_NOT_IDENTICAL: WAL-2 signs tool-source responses and relies on a WCA hierarchy; SCITT Signed Statement has no AUDIENCE/SCOPE/delegation semantics; SLSA L2 signs build provenance by platform not delegator; none carries attenuation
WHAT_NAC_MUST_ADD: AUDIENCE, SCOPE subset semantics, PARENT hash, trust-anchor binding, revocation; SIGNATURE_VALID != AUTHORIZED

NAC_SEMANTICS: TRANSPARENCY_ATTESTED: NAC-2 statement registered in a Transparency Service with receipt
WCA_WAL_NEAREST: WAL-3 (reference monitor RM1-RM3 + hash-chained attestation log + signed nonce queries) - different property: WAL-3 is mediation, not public transparency
SCITT_RFC9943_NEAREST: Transparent Statement = Signed Statement + COSE Receipt from TS under registration policy (RFC 9943; RFC 9942)
SLSA_V1_2_NEAREST: Build L3 (hardened build platform) - different property: tamper resistance during build, not transparency
WHY_NOT_IDENTICAL: SCITT receipt != NEXUS authorization and != scientific validity (RFC 9943 s9.2); does not prove issuance order (s9.1) or completeness (s9.3); WAL-3 reference-monitor is an enforcement property NAC-3 does not claim; SLSA L3 is a build-platform property
WHAT_NAC_MUST_ADD: Registration policy content; NEXUS authorization evaluation remains separate from receipt verification

NAC_SEMANTICS: Trust root + policy + scope + delegation semantics evaluated at verify time
WCA_WAL_NEAREST: Partial: WAL-3 complete mediation (RM1) is the nearest enforcement idea
SCITT_RFC9943_NEAREST: Out of scope in RFC 9943 (authN/authZ implementation-specific)
SLSA_V1_2_NEAREST: Out of scope (SLSA does not cover producer trust)
OTHER_PRIOR_ART_NEAREST: Biscuit authorizer with root key + Datalog; UCAN validation at execution time; A2A/MCP per-request authorization
WHY_NOT_IDENTICAL: None of the three define delegated-authority decisions

WCA_WAL_NEAREST: None (WCA addresses 'semantic laundering' of provenance, not truth)
SCITT_RFC9943_NEAREST: Explicitly not provided (s9.2 issuers can make false statements)
SLSA_V1_2_NEAREST: Explicitly not covered (code quality / producer trust)
WHY_NOT_IDENTICAL: Integrity/provenance mechanisms are orthogonal to truth
WHAT_NAC_MUST_ADD: NEXUS epistemic layer (claim ceilings such as C1, NCI, falsifiers) - unproven, NEXUS-specific
